subject: Rollout constraints, staffing matrix, and doc sign‑off
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Rollout constraints, initial staffing matrix and docs – need decisions by EOD Friday

Team —

Per last week’s planning sync, I’m consolidating the constraints that will shape the November -> December rollout window. High level: infra is capacity-constrained during 11/24–11/28 (holiday prep), we have a security-derived processing restriction for EU customers (requires final review), and DocOps needs signoff on the user-facing runbook before we open for beta.

Attached: staffing-matrix-v2.xlsx (proposed on-call & enablement leads), rollout-calendar-compact.pdf (two alternative windows), doc-signoff-checklist.md.

Ask: can each of you confirm the following by EOD Friday 11/20?
- Product (Marcus): final production feature list to lock for the first cohort.
- CS/Enablement (Marissa): training slot availability for onboarding sessions (we need two 90-min sessions in week 1).
- Runtime/Ops (Lukas): confirmation on autoscale headroom and fallback capacity for Dedicated customers.
- Kimberly: any SLA/leadership-level constraints we should bake into the calendar.

If there are any non-starters, flag them inline — I’ll compile and update the calendar on Monday.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout constraints, initial staffing matrix and docs – need decisions by EOD Friday

Thanks Evelyn —

Quick answers from Product: we should lock the GA surface for the first cohort to the API + Console flow only (no Private deployment enablement in wave 1). Rationale: reduces infra SKU variety and lets us validate core telemetry/observability.

Open question: can we delay embedding/index migration features to wave 2? There are outstanding evals and that will cut risk. If leadership needs embeddings in wave 1 for a customer POC (Acme), we’ll need a special exception and a committed SRE liaison.

Action: I’ll upload a short PRD excerpt to the Drive link tonight with the exact feature list.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Group PM, Platform
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-platform-team <platform@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout constraints, initial staffing matrix and docs – need decisions by EOD Friday

Couple of notes from Enablement/CS side:
- Training: I can run the two 90-min sessions on Mon 12/1 at 10am and Wed 12/3 at 2pm. Need confirmation on who from Product will present the feature overview (Marcus?).
- Docs: DocOps reviewed the checklist — the user runbook needs example org mappings for Dedicated customers (we currently only have hosted examples). That’s a small writer task but needs runtime review.
- Acme POC: Acme wants embeddings in wave 1. They’re on a tight procurement timeline (hubspot HS-34567). If Product and SRE approve a scoped exception (embedding disabled for other customers; Acme-only flag + telemetry), CS will prioritize the enablement work.

I attached an updated staffing-matrix-v2.xlsx (tab: enablement) with suggested on-call pairings.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Enablement
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: sre-consultant@thirdparty.io
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout constraints, initial staffing matrix and docs – need decisions by EOD Friday

Ops capacity check:
- Autoscale: we have ~25% headroom for hosted APIs in the candidate windows; Dedicated pools are near-commit limits on several SKUs (NVIDIA H100 medium). We can buy a small burst window but that requires procurement & cloud partner signoff — likely a 48–72 hour lead time.
- Fallbacks: we can implement per-request model fallback to a quantized variant to reduce memory footprint; this requires a runtime toggle and one quick canary (2–4 hours).
- EU security restriction: security team needs to re-run the data residency checklist for embeddings (this is the blocker for Acme if they want embeddings). I’ve looped the SRE consultant for a quick read.

Immediate ask: if Acme embeddings are required week-1, we need a signed exception from leadership and a dedicated SRE on-call for the first 72 hours post-launch. Without that, we should push embeddings to wave 2.

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout constraints, initial staffing matrix and docs – need decisions by EOD Friday

Thanks all — concise decisions below so Evelyn can update the calendar:
- Scope: Product locks GA scope to API + Console only for wave 1. Embeddings/features that impact storage/ residency are deferred to wave 2 unless Acme pays for an exception. (Marcus confirmed offline and will publish the PRD excerpt by EOD.)
- Enablement: Marissa to run two training sessions (12/1 10am, 12/3 2pm). Marcus to present the feature overview in both. Marissa to circulate slide deck 48 hours prior.
- Ops: Lukas to schedule a 2-hour canary for the fallback quantized model on Tue 11/30 — please coordinate with SRE consultant. If we see >10% mem improvement in canary, we’ll enable fallback for the first 72 hours.
- Acme exception: Denied for now unless Acme signs the exception fee and accepts a restricted POC SLA. Marissa — please confirm whether Acme is prepared to move on the fee; if yes, we’ll re-evaluate.
- Docs: DocOps to add Dedicated examples (small writer task). Once DocOps marks the checklist complete (doc-signoff-checklist.md), Kimberly will do final signoff.

Evelyn, please update the rollout-calendar-compact.pdf with these decisions and publish a single canonical calendar to the Drive link.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-platform-team <platform@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rollout constraints, initial staffing matrix and docs – need decisions by EOD Friday

Acknowledged — I’ll follow up with Acme on the exception fee (HS-34567) and push the slide deck to Drive by Sun night. Also flagged the DocOps task with the writer; ETA for Dedicated examples is Mon 11/23 EOD.

Action items I own:
- Circulate slides and training invites (by 11/22).
- Confirm Acme exception feasibility and cost (by 11/22).
- Update staffing-matrix-v2.xlsx with final on-call pairs and share with Lukas for canary coverage.

If anyone needs me to swap one of the training slots for a different timezone-friendly option, say so before Monday.

— Marissa
